 NEU! Festival 2026-2027 in Girona: Iván Ferreiro, Yerai Cortés and Triángulo de Amor Bizarro, programme by date and tickets
 Redacción ModoFestival · Editor: Lucas Moreno 
 13 Nov 2026, 08:00 
 A 3-minute read 
 Goldorak / Wikimedia Commons (CC BY-SA 4.0) 
 Follow us on Google 
 In short
 Iván Ferreiro opens NEU! Festival on 4 December at La Mirona , with the tour marking his 35-year career and tickets at €30, in a co-production with Temporada Alta. 
 La Gran Nit del NEU! brings together Triángulo de Amor Bizarro, Jimena Amarillo and Minibús Intergalàctic on 16 January , along with Renaldo & Clara, xicu and kara boi, for €26. 
 Yerai Cortés presents ‘POPULAR’ in Girona for the first time on 22 January , with a full band at the Auditori. 
 There are thirteen events across Girona and Salt from 4 December to 23 January , some of them free, with sales split between DICE and each venue's box office. 
 NEU! Festival now has its full programme for its 13th edition . The independent music series in Girona and Salt will run from 4 December 2026 to 23 January 2027 , with concerts spread across clubs, theatres and other spaces in the two towns. Iván Ferreiro opens it, a free morning session on Saturday 23rd closes it, and in between come Yerai Cortés, Triángulo de Amor Bizarro and Rita Payés, as well as an industry day, NEU! PRO.
 Iván Ferreiro opens NEU! Festival at La Mirona
 Iván Ferreiro kicks off the festival on Friday 4 December at 22:00 at La Mirona , in co-production with Temporada Alta. He arrives with ‘Hoy x Ayer’, the tour celebrating his 35-year career, which revisits his songs from Los Piratas to the present day. Tickets cost €30 through Temporada Alta's ticket sales.
 In 2027 he has already been announced for festivals such as SanSan and Spring Festival Alicante .
 Triángulo de Amor Bizarro at a concert in 2024. Image: Alterna2 / Wikimedia Commons (CC BY 2.0) La Gran Nit del NEU!, on 16 January
 The festival's big night is Saturday 16 January at La Mirona , with doors opening at 18:00. The line-up brings together Triángulo de Amor Bizarro , Jimena Amarillo , Minibús Intergalàctic , Renaldo & Clara, xicu and kara boi. Tickets cost €26 on DICE.
 Minibús Intergalàctic is also on the first line-up for Ebroclub Sixties Weekend 2027 , in Miranda de Ebro, and Triángulo de Amor Bizarro on that of Degusta Fest in Armilla.
 Yerai Cortés presents ‘POPULAR’ at the Auditori
 Guitarist Yerai Cortés will present ‘POPULAR’ with a full band on Friday 22 January at 20:00 at the Auditori de Girona . It will be his first concert in the city, according to the festival. The Auditori's ticket sales show prices of €36 and €40 depending on the area.
 That same morning, the Auditori hosts the fifth edition of NEU! PRO , the day for music industry professionals, which moves to that venue this year. Registration is not yet open.
 NEU! Festival 2026-2027 programme by date
 This is the full programme published by the festival, with the prices shown by each ticket outlet on 12 November:
 Friday 4 December, 22:00: Iván Ferreiro, at La Mirona. €30.
 Friday 11 December, 20:00: Orchestra Fireluche, at La Planeta. €16.50 on DICE.
 Saturday 12 December, 12:00: Paco Pecado, at La Volta. Free entry.
 Saturday 12 December, 21:00: La Sotana live, with a concert by Ypnosi, at La Mirona. €21 on DICE.
 Sunday 13 December, 18:00: Eduard Canimas presents ‘La Còsmica del Caos’ at the Centre Cultural La Mercè. €20 plus fees on Entradium.
 Friday 18 December, 22:00: Foresta, at the Ateneu Popular de Salt. €12 on DICE.
 Saturday 9 January, 20:00: Rita Payés and Lucía Fumero present ‘Rueda eterna’ at the Teatre Municipal de Girona. On sale at the theatre's box office, which does not give the price outside the purchase process.
 Sunday 10 January, 20:00: Smoking Bambino, at the Sunset Jazz Club. €15 on DICE.
 Saturday 16 January, 18:00: La Gran Nit del NEU!, at La Mirona. €26 on DICE.
 Wednesday 20 January, 19:00: screening of the documentary ‘Però abans d'això hi haurà set’, about Remei de Ca la Fresca, at La Marfà. Free entry, according to Mondo Sonoro.
 Friday 22 January, 10:00: NEU! PRO, at the Auditori de Girona.
 Friday 22 January, 20:00: Yerai Cortés, at the Auditori de Girona. €36 to €40.
 Saturday 23 January, 12:00: Carme Vives and Sant Rocs, at the Estació Espai Jove. Free entry.
 Where to buy tickets
 There is no festival pass: each concert is sold separately via the official NEU! Festival website , which links to the ticket sales for each event. Concerts at La Planeta, La Mirona, the Ateneu de Salt and the Sunset Jazz Club are sold on DICE; Iván Ferreiro's at the Temporada Alta box office; Yerai Cortés at the Auditori's; Rita Payés and Lucía Fumero at the Teatre Municipal's; and Eduard Canimas on Entradium. The rest of this period's events are in our listings of December festivals and January festivals .
 Sources: official NEU! Festival website (2026-27 edition programme), accessed on 12 November 2026; official ticket sales on Temporada Alta, DICE, Entradium, Giglon and Koobin (Auditori de Girona), accessed on 12 November 2026; Enderrock and Mondo Sonoro, 12 November 2026.
